name: Love one another
description: Seven days on love in friendship, marriage and family: patient, honest, forgiving and kind.

days.title: What love is
days.devotional:
Paul describes love that waits patiently and acts kindly, and he lists what it refuses to be: proud, rude, easily angered, keeping score.

Read it slowly and put your own name where love is described. Where do you need grace?
days.prayer: God, You are love. Grow this kind of love in me.
questions: Which description of love is hardest for you?
Who needs your patience this week?

days.title: A friend who stays
days.note: The friendship of David and Jonathan.
days.devotional:
Jonathan loves David as himself and keeps faith with him, even at great cost.

True friendship is loyal and generous.
days.prayer: Lord, thank You for my friends. Make me a loyal friend.
questions: Who has been a Jonathan to you?
How could you be a better friend this week?

days.title: The way Jesus loves
days.devotional:
Jesus sets the standard: love each other the way He has loved us, even laying down life for friends.

We love because we have first been loved.
days.prayer: Jesus, thank You for calling me Your friend. Help me love like You.
questions: What does it mean to you that Jesus calls you friend?
What is one sacrificial act of love you could do?

days.title: Marriage and mutual love
days.note: Paul describes marriage as a picture of Christ and the church.
days.devotional:
Paul starts with submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ. Marriage is meant to show self-giving love.

Whether married or not, this calls us to put others' good first.
days.prayer: Lord, teach me self-giving love in my closest relationships.
questions: What does self-giving love look like at home?
Where could you put someone else's good first?

days.title: Ruth's loyalty
days.devotional:
In grief and loss, Ruth chooses to stay with her mother-in-law, binding her life to Naomi's people and God.

Love often looks like staying.
days.prayer: God, give me Ruth's faithfulness to the people You've given me.
questions: Who needs you to stay close right now?
How has someone's loyalty helped you?

days.title: Honest and gentle
days.note: Paul urges unity, patience and honest love.
days.devotional:
Love is not avoiding hard conversations; it is saying what is true, gently, so that we grow together.

Gentleness and patience keep the peace between us.
days.prayer: Lord, help me speak honestly and gently, and keep peace with others.
questions: Is there a truth you need to speak in love?
How can you keep it gentle?

days.title: Love in action
days.note: John says love shows up in deeds.
days.devotional:
Love is more than words; it shows up in actions and in truth. Seeing a need and helping is love made visible.

End this week by doing one loving thing nobody asked for.
days.prayer: God, make my love practical and real today.
questions: What need around you could you meet?
What one loving act will you do today?
